{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches release notes alongside the code change.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Updating release notes as part of a code change does not make the PR a documentation PR."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Private Broadcast label and alters the node's private transaction broadcast synchronization behavior.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "unblocks #N",
      "rationale": "Provides the synchronization needed for external clients and unblocks private broadcast integration in the wallet. The PR description notes that waiting synchronously for mempool acceptance resolves issues where software expects transactions in the mempool post-broadcast, and is a prerequisite for adding private broadcast support to the wallet."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Touches src/rpc/mempool.cpp and src/rpc/client.cpp, adding an optional timeout parameter to sendrawtransaction.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "user request",
      "rationale": "Fixes caller assumptions around sendrawtransaction by allowing callers to wait for mempool inclusion. The PR description notes that third-party wallets and services call sendrawtransaction and expect the transaction to be in the mempool after a successful response."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "The test modifications are functional tests specifically verifying private broadcast behavior.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests validating a specific subsystem belong to that area rather than test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches src/common/messages.cpp for 4 lines of string translation.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Minor message strings update incidental to the broadcast feature does not constitute a utility change."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/validationinterface.h to add a callback without altering validation logic or chainstate invariants.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Adding an event hook to CValidationInterface to bypass the async queue does not substantively alter transaction validation rules, chainstate, or consensus processing."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 1,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 2,
    "leverage": 2
  }
}
